scripts.dev: concurrently "bun run dev:gateway" "bun run dev:user" "bun run dev:event" "bun run dev:registration" "bun run dev:feedback" "bun run dev:notification" "bun run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently "bun run dev:gateway" "bun run dev:user" "bun run dev:event" "bun run dev:registration" "bun run dev:feedback" "bun run dev:notification"
scripts.build: bun run build:shared && bun run build:services && bun run build:frontend
scripts.build:services: concurrently "bun run build:gateway" "bun run build:user" "bun run build:event" "bun run build:registration" "bun run build:feedback" "bun run build:notification"
scripts.migration:run:all: for dir in services/user-service services/event-service services/registration-service services/feedback-service services/notification-service; do (cd $dir && bun run migration:run); done
scripts.seed:all: for dir in services/user-service services/event-service services/registration-service services/feedback-service services/notification-service; do (cd $dir && bun run seed); done
